goal: Enterprise dashboard parity with Fireblocks/Coinbase Prime/Anchorage/BitGo/Chainalysis-class platforms

nodes.title: Dashboard shell: sidebar nav hosting Treasury/Transactions/Policies/Compliance/Audit/Security pages
nodes.notes: Extend showcase/src/app/dashboard/ with a shared layout + sidebar. Keep existing org/keys/usage content as the Overview page. Placeholder pages for the rest so each later node fills one in.

nodes.title: Treasury API: org-wide multi-chain balances + historical portfolio value
nodes.notes: DONE: GET /enterprise/orgs/:orgId/treasury + /treasury/history in api-ts/src/routes/enterprise.ts. Reuses BalanceService (native balances, live USD). History is swap-flow derived proxy; real orgTreasurySnapshots table deferred (needs dual-ORM migration). ERC-20 balances excluded (matches existing portfolio limitation).

nodes.title: Treasury page: multi-chain balance table + portfolio value chart (lightweight-charts)
nodes.notes: Per-chain and per-asset breakdown, total value header, 30d value chart.

nodes.title: Transaction monitoring API: filterable org transaction history + CSV export
nodes.notes: GET /v1/enterprise/orgs/:id/transactions — swaps/executions/fees joined, filters: chain, status, member, date range, min value. ?format=csv streams CSV.

nodes.title: Transactions page: filterable table, status badges, detail drawer, export button
Audit trail API: filtered reads of hash-chained auditLogs + chain verification + CSV export
nodes.notes: GET /v1/enterprise/orgs/:id/audit — reads auditLogs (schema/security.ts), verify endpoint recomputes hash chain and reports first broken link. Admin+ role.

nodes.title: Audit Trail page: event stream, actor/event filters, chain-integrity badge, export
nodes.notes: Tamper-evidence surfaced: green 'chain verified' / red 'broken at entry N'.

nodes.title: Policy engine schema: transfer policies, allowlists, approval requests with quorum
nodes.notes: Drizzle tables: orgPolicies (type: tx_limit|daily_limit|velocity|allowlist_only, threshold, quorum, tiered spending-limit à la Safe), orgAllowlistAddresses, policyApprovalRequests + approvals. Additive migration via bun run db:generate.

nodes.title: Policy API: policy CRUD, allowlist mgmt, approval request/approve/reject with quorum enforcement
nodes.notes: Owner/admin mutate policies; approvals need quorum distinct approvers; every mutation writes auditLogs. Include signed policy-export endpoint (Fireblocks differentiator): JSON snapshot + entryHash.

nodes.title: Policies page: rule builder, allowlist manager, pending-approvals queue with approve/reject
nodes.notes: Quorum progress indicators (2-of-3 style), policy export download button.

nodes.title: Compliance API: screening events, mode (ENFORCE/MONITOR), OFAC stats, token risk scores
nodes.notes: Surface bot/services/compliance data. If screening events aren't persisted yet, add a screening_events table (additive, both ORMs via db-migrate pattern) and write from compliance_service; api-ts reads it.

nodes.title: Compliance page: screening stats, blocked-tx list, mode indicator, address risk lookup
nodes.notes: Chainalysis-style: alert list w/ severity, filterable by chain/direction.

nodes.title: Security Center: unified page — pending approvals, blocked txs, recent admin actions, API key activity, member sessions
nodes.notes: Fireblocks Security Center pattern: one incident-review screen aggregating the other APIs.

nodes.title: Reporting: monthly statement endpoint (tx summary, fees, holdings) as CSV + JSON
nodes.notes: GET /v1/enterprise/orgs/:id/reports/:period — accounting-friendly rows (Coinbase Prime journal-entry pattern). UI: download buttons on Overview.

nodes.title: Alerts: org webhook config + dispatch on threshold breach, policy trigger, screening hit
nodes.notes: orgWebhooks table (url, secret, event types), HMAC-signed POST dispatch helper called from policy/compliance paths. SIEM-friendly JSON payloads.
